name: Andreas Hofer
beschreibung: The Hotel Andreas Hofer is centrally located in **Kufstein**, just a short walk from the train station and the fortress. The rooms are furnished with local woods and offer views of the old town or the **Inntal** valley. The restaurant serves regional dishes and international cuisine. A wellness area with a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation zone is available for guests. Several rooms with modern facilities are available for conferences and celebrations. The hotel features its own underground parking with limited spaces. The location allows easy access on foot to the city center and nearby hiking trails.
